name: Sweet Lands

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the Action phase of round 5 (no cleanup), then final scoring

categories.label: Victory points earned during the game
categories.hint: VP gained through passes, actions and abilities during the 5 rounds.

categories.label: Prosperity: terrain tiles
categories.hint: VP from Terrain Tiles on your map (any side) at the rate set by the top Prosperity Track (e.g. 1 VP per 3 / per 2 / per tile).

categories.label: Prosperity: Cookie Rabbit tokens
categories.hint: VP from Cookie Rabbit tokens on your map at the rate of its Prosperity Track.

categories.label: Prosperity: road tokens
categories.hint: VP from Road tokens on your map at the rate of its Prosperity Track.

categories.label: Prosperity: property tokens
categories.hint: VP from Property tokens on your map (incl. Clock Tower) at the rate of its Prosperity Track.

categories.label: Prosperity: automated cards
categories.labelVi: Thịnh vượng: thẻ tự động hóa
categories.hint: VP from automated cards at the rate of its Prosperity Track.

categories.label: Prosperity: industry points
categories.hint: VP from Industry Points earned at the rate of its Prosperity Track.

categories.label: City Points earned
categories.hint: Total City Points earned in the game; each is worth 2 VP.

categories.label: Bonus: all 5 Tent tokens placed
categories.hint: Enter Cookie Rabbit tokens on your map if all 5 Tent tokens are placed (else 0); 2 VP each.

categories.label: Bonus: all 5 House tokens placed (City Points)
categories.hint: Enter City Points earned if all 5 House tokens are placed (else 0); 1 VP each.

categories.label: Bonus: all 5 Building tokens placed (Industry Points)
categories.hint: Enter Industry Points earned if all 5 Building tokens are placed (else 0); 1 VP each.

categories.label: Connected Ports (0-4)
categories.hint: Ports linked to a Capital hex by a continuous path of terrain tiles: 0=-40, 1=-20, 2=-10, 3=-5, 4=+10.

categories.label: Milestone tiles collected
categories.hint: 10 VP per Milestone tile (max 3 collected in the game; none in solo).

categories.label: Final scoring tile 1 (rank)
categories.hint: Compare the indicated element among players: 1st 15 VP, 2nd 7 VP; tied players all get the full amount for that rank and the next rank is skipped. Neutral virtual player only blocks places.

categories.label: Final scoring tile 2 (rank)
categories.hint: Same as tile 1 for the second randomly chosen final scoring tile.

categories.label: Cookie Rabbit tokens on map (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Số thỏ Cookie trên bản đồ (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Tiebreaker: most Cookie Rabbit tokens on your map board.

tiebreakers.description: Most Cookie Rabbit tokens on the player's map board
If still tied, the tied players share the victory

notes: family: point-salad-euro. Prosperity-track rates depend on each marker's position (printed on the main board; e.g. top track 1 VP per 3 tiles at spaces 1-2, per 2 at 3-4, per tile at the end), so enter the computed VP per track. Tent/House/Building bonus categories: enter the count only when all 5 of that token are on your map. Final scoring tiles: enter the compared quantity for each player; a neutral virtual player may occupy a rank (it earns nothing but can push real players down) - not modelled. Solo mode (Mio) has no milestones/final tiles; target scores 250/300. Rules read from RulesPal rulebook text (mirrors the official rulebook); official BGG PDF download was blocked.
